front: Masses of C and H from combustion products?
back: Mass of C = mass of CO₂ × 12/44; mass of H = mass of H₂O × 2/18; O by difference.

front: How do you find x in a hydrated salt MX.xH₂O?
back: Heat to constant mass; water = mass lost; x = moles of water ÷ moles of anhydrous salt.
